ablation.context_ablation: remove adaptation context; meta MUST drop to FLOOR (proves context use)
ablation.shuffle_structure: reuse 001A shuffle world; meta headroom MUST collapse (<=DELTA)

authorization_gate: Implementation requires (1) explicit operator 'implement TLGP-001B' instruction AND (2) reference to THIS frozen prereg sha256. Until both, design-only.
auto_remote_anchor_policy: LOCAL-ONLY default; harness performs NO git op; remote BLOCKED until scripts/push.* hardcoded-PAT rotated/removed; any remote anchor operator-initiated only, scoped explicit `git add`, NEVER `git add -A`, NEVER push.py
claim_ceiling: Bounded offline evidence on whether ONE procedural world's within-episode inference headroom survives cross-episode amortization. Candidate-free; tests NO mechanism. NOT learning-as-mechanism, agency, self, feeling, subjectivity, intelligence, or EGO-readiness evidence. A negative in either direction is bounded to THIS world + THIS meta-learner family + this pre-registered capacity grid.

decision_statistic.H1_requires: LCB > DELTA at the LARGEST capacity of every meta-learner family

metric.note: ideal = TLGP-001A in-family Bayesian observer (probe ceiling, excluded from fair panel)
metric.primary: mean over episodes of per-episode balanced accuracy on held-out queries

panel.graph_cache_family_note: graph_lookup/transition_table/successor_map/count_table/episodic_traversal provably dominated by unseen-value split; include count_table witness, expect floor; coverage by construction, not independent corroboration

positive_control.leakage: meta NEVER receives rule_id or query_e; reuse 001A dual-target MI detector (planted + RENAMED + clean controls) on every meta input channel
positive_control.meta_learner_capable: SAME architecture+budget trained on CAPACITY_CONTROL regime MUST close headroom on >=9/10 seeds; else INVALID (underpowered meta-learner)

provenance_requirements.code_path_provenance: delivered_sha256 == executed_sha256 for every src file, recorded
provenance_requirements.fuse_safe_write: author in /tmp, cp to mount, sha256 readback verify
provenance_requirements.prereg_pin: this prereg sha256 embedded in result.json before any score is computed

question: Does TLGP-001A's within-episode headroom survive a capacity-saturated cross-episode meta-learner that may amortize the mod-K rule family across episodes?

replay_requirements.exactness: ideal exact; baseline/meta from recorded preds exact; stochastic retraining reproducibility checked separately via frozen MODEL_SEEDS + capacity control
replay_requirements.from_trace_no_retrain: recompute ideal + every baseline + meta balanced accuracy AND the verdict from recorded predictions vs ground truth, WITHOUT retraining
replay_requirements.power_statement: REQUIRED on the fired verdict (min detectable headroom gap at N_SEEDS=10 + observed std)

assertions_logged: test set identical across REAL and CONTROL
split_construction.episode_split: train/val draw rules from TRAIN_RULES only; test draws from TEST_RULES only; episode_id disjoint across splits

rule_split.method: permutation of the 625 canonical-order rules by RULE_SPLIT_SEED; disjoint

value_regime.CAPACITY_CONTROL: identical EXCEPT train+val episode QUERIES may also draw {3,4} (adapt still {0,1,2}); test identical to REAL
value_regime.REAL_withheld: train+val episodes use values {0,1,2} for BOTH adaptation and queries (meta never sees 3/4); test uses 001A protocol (adapt {0,1,2}, query {3,4})

axes: inflate a fair baseline above FLOOR+DELTA -> not-H1
mark a planted leak missed -> INVALID
degrade meta_learner_capable below close threshold -> INVALID
tamper_requirements.requirement: each probe MUST flip the computed verdict (fail-able both ways)

precedence_computed: INVALID iff (capacity_control fails to close on >=9/10 seeds for any family) OR (any planted leak uncaught) OR (any clean channel falsely flagged) OR (replay not exact)
else SURVIVES (H1) iff for the largest capacity of every family: LCB(headroom_vs_meta) > DELTA AND context-ablation collapses (meta <= FLOOR+DELTA) AND shuffle collapses (meta headroom <= DELTA)

world.inherit: TLGP-001A frozen world (read-only import of src/tlgp_001a.world)
